episodes.overview: When her escape plan falls through, Se-ri turns to another idea for a way out. Dan heads to the village to see Jeong Hyeok.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jeong Hyeok agrees to marry Dan sooner, as his parents wish, but they must do him a favor first. Seung-jun catches a glimpse of Se-ri.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Dan is less than happy when she hears Jeong Hyeok and Se-ri are at a hotel together. Meanwhile, Seung-jun plays what cards he has to save himself.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A flight out of North Korea awaits Se-ri at the airport. But unwilling to leave Jeong Hyeok while he's injured, she brings him to the hospital instead.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Keeping Jeong Hyeok away from Se-ri turns out to be much more difficult than Seung-jun anticipated. Cheol Gang stays on their tail.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Se-ri faces her kidnapper. Elsewhere, Jeong Hyeok is forced to spread a formidable rumor about himself in order to escape Cheol Gang's clutches.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Back to her cushy life in the spotlight, Se-ri takes care of business — though nothing feels quite the same. Jeong Hyeok goes after Cheol Gang.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: It's Jeong Hyeok's turn to adjust to a new world. Back in North Korea, Dan gives Seung-jun a place to stay after he loses his protection.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Hoping to meet Jeong Hyeok, his comrades attend an event hosted by Se-ri's company. Seung-jun opens up to Dan over a bowl of rice porridge.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Se-ri sends the comrades on a shopping spree, and plays hooky from work with Jeong Hyeok. Jung Man Bok encounters a dilemma.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: While Jeong Hyeok keeps watch over Se-ri, his comrades make themselves useful. Seung-jun can't stop worrying about Dan.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: South Korean officials try to figure out what's going on, but they're given conflicting stories. Seung-jun flees from his captors.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Before departing, Jeong Hyeok leaves behind a surprise that keeps on giving. Dan delivers bittersweet justice.

shows.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
shows.overview: Percy Jackson is on a dangerous quest. Outrunning monsters and outwitting gods, he must journey across America to return Zeus's master bolt and stop an all-out war. With the help of his friends Annabeth and Grover, Percy's journey will lead him closer to the answers he seeks: how to fit into a world where he feels out of place, and who he's destined to be.

shows.name: Person of Interest
shows.overview: John Reese, former CIA paramilitary operative, is presumed dead and teams up with reclusive billionaire Finch to prevent violent crimes in New York City by initiating their own type of justice. With the special training that Reese has had in Covert Operations and Finch's genius software inventing mind, the two are a perfect match for the job that they have to complete. With the help of surveillance equipment, they work "outside the law" and get the right criminal behind bars.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A supercomputer developed by reclusive billionaire and software genius Harold Finch analyzes data patterns in surveillance for the U.S. government to identify impending acts of terrorism. But the computer, known only as "The Machine", can also identify ordinary people who are about to be involved in violent crimes. Can those crimes be stopped before they take place? Secretly tapping into The Machine, Finch and ex-CIA agent John Reese use vigilante tactics and state-of-the-art technology to identify the soon-to-be victims and prevent the crimes from occuring. Meanwhile, two NYPD detectives Joss Carter and Lionel Fusco are drawn into the cases and the mystery surrounding the two covert crime fighters.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: When the social security number of a young prosecutor comes up, Reese and Finch work together to figure out if their person of interest is the victim or perpetrator.

episodes.name: Ghosts
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch question the machine's reliability when they are asked to investigate a teenager who was killed years earlier; Finch remembers the origin of the machine.

episodes.name: Mission Creep
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover to find the threat surrounding the next person on Finch's list: a young army veteran named Joey Durban.

episodes.name: Cura Te Ipsum
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch get some help from Detective Fusco  as they surveil their latest POI, Dr. Megan Tillman, while she’s on call and after hours to unravel the threat surrounding the promising young physician.

episodes.name: Judgement
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch have the added challenge of investigating a Person of Interest who wants nothing to do with their brand of vigilante justice.

episodes.name: The Fix
episodes.overview: Reese becomes romantically involved with the newest Person of Interest: an attractive woman who isn't all that she seems.

episodes.name: Witness
episodes.overview: The Machine identifies a school teacher who witnessed a mob hit as their next POI and Reese and Finch rush to save his life.

episodes.name: Foe
episodes.overview: When Reese and Finch discover that their latest POI has connections to Cold War Soviet espionage circles, they quickly learn how covert ops were handled in a world before The Machine.

episodes.name: Get Carter
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch’s game of cat and mouse with Detective Carter becomes infinitely more complicated when The Machine declares that she is their newest POI.

episodes.name: Number Crunch
episodes.overview: As Detective Carter deals with the fallout from her recent encounter with Reese and Finch, The Machine ups the ante for the duo by giving them four Social Security numbers instead of one.

episodes.name: Super
episodes.overview: Reese is confined to a wheelchair recovering from his gunshot wound, but Finch sets him up in an apartment where he’s to keep an eye on the Super, who is their latest POI. Also, Finch approaches Carter and gives her a POI to show her what they do.

episodes.name: Legacy
episodes.overview: When Carter finally comes face-to-face with Reese, he urges her to join forces to help with their latest POI, a scrappy young woman from the wrong side of the tracks who turned her life around and became a lawyer.

episodes.name: Root Cause
episodes.overview: The Machine gives Reese and Finch the number of a down-and-out man who has been pushed too far, and they're forced to turn to former Person of Interest, Zoe Morgan, for help.

episodes.name: Wolf and Cub
episodes.overview: The Machine identifies Darren, a teenager whose brother was just murdered, as the next POI. Meanwhile, Finch is growing concerned that the son of his former business partner is dangerously close to finding out about the Machine.

episodes.name: Blue Code
episodes.overview: Reese discovers there’s more to the story after he infiltrates a smuggling ring to get close to his latest POI.

episodes.name: Risk
episodes.overview: The Machine leads Reese and Finch to Wall Street when a sharp young trader at a major investment bank becomes embroiled in a multi-million dollar financial scam.

episodes.name: Baby Blue
episodes.overview: When The Machine spits out the number of a 6-month-old baby, Reese and Finch turn into overly protective parents – with an arsenal at their disposal. Meanwhile, when Elias resurfaces, Detective Carter begins to question her new allegiance with Reese and Finch.

episodes.name: Identity Crisis
episodes.overview: The Machine's latest number presents a unique challenge for Reese and Finch since the person has virtually no digital footprint - and appears to be leading a double life.

episodes.name: Flesh and Blood
episodes.overview: When The Machine spits out five numbers, naming the Don of each of New York’s crime families, Reese and Finch suspect Elias is planning to eliminate his competition.

episodes.name: Matsya Nyaya
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover as an armored car company employee, and faces memories from his past with the CIA.

episodes.name: Many Happy Returns
episodes.overview: Finch gives Reese his birthday off so that his partner doesn't have to face a Number that is tied to Reese's past.

episodes.name: No Good Deed
episodes.overview: The newest POI’s curiosity could spell his doom when he finds himself embroiled in a dark government conspiracy – one that Finch is all too familiar with. Meanwhile, Reese uncovers something revealing about Finch’s past.

episodes.name: Firewall
episodes.overview: As the clock ticks down, Reese winds up trapped with his POI in the most heavily surveilled part of the city, forced to rely on the help of Finch, Carter and Fusco to fend off the FBI, corrupt cops and a slew of old foes.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The Machine identifies another gripping season's worth of potential crimes that must be stopped. Adversaries from Reese's undercover past and Finch's government work threaten the team's crime-fighting mission and anonymity. Meanwhile, Detectives Carter and Fusco face down FBI probes and the dangerous tentacles of the police conspiracy known as "HR".

episodes.name: The Contingency
episodes.overview: With Finch missing – kidnapped by his hacker nemesis, Root, Reese enlists Detectives Carter and Fusco to get his friend back, Meanwhile, The Machine never sleeps, disseminating a new number to Reese.

episodes.name: Bad Code
episodes.overview: The Machine delivers the number of a cold case that leads Reese ever closer to catching up with Finch and his kidnapper, Root.

episodes.name: Masquerade
episodes.overview: With Finch back in the Library, Reese returns to field work, only to face his toughest case yet – protecting the privileged daughter of a Brazilian diplomat.

episodes.name: Triggerman
episodes.overview: When The Machine gives them the number of a mob enforcer whose life becomes endangered, Reese and Finch must decide whether to intervene or allow karma to balance the scales of justice. Meanwhile, Finch seeks aid from an unlikely source.

episodes.name: Bury the Lede
episodes.overview: Reese must protect an investigative journalist through surreptitious means to avoid becoming part of her story.

episodes.name: The High Road
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover in an idyllic neighborhood when The Machine’s latest number sends him to the suburbs.

episodes.name: Critical
episodes.overview: The Machine gives Finch and Reese the number of a brilliant surgeon, but they soon discover that a resourceful third party has raised the stakes for this POI, forcing them to turn to an unlikely source for help.

episodes.name: Til Death
episodes.overview: The team is spread thin when a husband and wife’s numbers both come up

episodes.name: C.O.D.
episodes.overview: When the machine names a New York cabdriver as a person of interest, any of his passengers could be a part of the impending crime.

episodes.name: Shadow Box
episodes.overview: As the FBI pursues "the man in the suit," Reese is even more determined to protect the latest person of interest after learning she is the sister of a soldier who was killed in action.

episodes.name: 2πR
episodes.overview: Finch goes under cover to protect a youth who reminds him of himself; Carter goes on a dangerous mission for the FBI.

episodes.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
episodes.overview: Carter tries to help Reese by engaging in mental warfare with the FBI; Reese has encounters with old and new enemies; Detective Fusco must protect supermodel Karolina Kurkova, the latest person of interest.

episodes.name: Dead Reckoning
episodes.overview: Reese is abducted by a former acquaintance planning a massive and potentially deadly act of cyber-warfare.

episodes.name: One Percent
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese meet their match: a tech billionaire whose curiosity and endless resources could expose their identities and ruin their efforts to save his life.

episodes.name: Booked Solid
episodes.overview: As Reese and Finch try to save a hotel maid's life, they encounter a litany of suspects; Detective Carter considers a significant offer from the FBI.

episodes.name: Relevance
episodes.overview: A lethal government operative who tracks and stops terrorist threats before they occur finds herself on the run – and the new focus of Reese and Finch's attention. However, their pursuit proves to be their most formidable when they discover that her remarkable skill set equals their own.

episodes.name: Proteus
episodes.overview: As Finch and Reese try to protect six people simultaneously, clues lead them to a coastal town; when a storm forces Finch and Reese to seek shelter in a police station with a group of locals, they realize a killer may be in their midst.

episodes.name: All In
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese head to Atlantic City to protect the latest person of interest, an elderly gambler; Carter tries to clear another detective's name.

episodes.name: Trojan Horse
episodes.overview: Finch infiltrates a tech corporation to gather intel on an executive whose number has come up; Carter questions Beecher's integrity.

episodes.name: In Extremis
episodes.overview: When a person of interest is poisoned, Finch and Reese only have 24 hours to identify the toxin and find the person responsible; Detective Fusco's past catches up to him.

episodes.name: Zero Day
episodes.overview: When a virus causes the machine to malfunction, numbers are issued irregularly; the team searches for an extremely elusive tech millionaire.

episodes.name: God Mode
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese team up with unexpected allies as they race to fix the machine; as Detective Carter tries to apprehend Cal Beecher's murderer, she finds herself up against HR -- a criminal organization.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The team suffers a devastating loss and confront staggering challenges. Adapting to the next evolution of The Machine, now completely self-governed and hidden from all, Finch and Reese team with rogue agent Sameen Shaw to save lives and seek justice, but their missions now threaten to tear them apart. Joss Carter and Lionel Fusco finally unravel the criminal police conspiracy "HR" - but at a tragic cost. And former cyber-enemy — and now highly tuned confederate of The Machine — Root becomes an unpredictable ally when the team learns a second surveillance apparatus to rival The Machine is on the verge of activation.

episodes.name: Liberty
episodes.overview: The Machine, now completely self-governed with its whereabouts unknown, resumes giving Finch its "irrelevant" numbers for people in danger, which include a U.S. naval officer in town for Fleet Week. However, with so many sailors flooding the streets of New York City, finding the officer in time presents an even bigger challenge for Reese and Shaw.

episodes.name: Nothing to Hide
episodes.overview: The number comes up for an Internet entrepreneur in the business of eliminating people's privacy, but finds his own being rapidly stripped away. As his life spirals out of control, Reese tries to protect him while Finch calls on Shaw, Carter and Fusco for help finding whoever is after him.

episodes.name: Lady Killer
episodes.overview: The team suspects the latest number to be a potential stalker/ killer. Root plots her escape from the institution and gives her psychiatrist a big surprise.

episodes.name: Reasonable Doubt
episodes.overview: The team must figure out if a prominent lawyer orchestrated the murder of her husband or if she is being framed; Carter is spotted with Reese by her new partner.

episodes.name: Razgovor
episodes.overview: Shaw must stay close to a 10-year-old girl with highly developed surveillance skills when she is identified by the machine; Carter's mission could be exposed.

episodes.name: Mors Praematura
episodes.overview: After being freed from her confinement to the psych ward, Root needs Shaw's help with a directive from the machine; Finch and Reese look into a mild-mannered investigator.

episodes.name: The Perfect Mark
episodes.overview: The team is met with surprises during an investigation into a hypnotherapist; an antiquities dealer has ties to a crime organization.

episodes.name: Endgame
episodes.overview: The machine gives Finch 38 numbers at once; information about Carter's past is revealed.

episodes.name: The Crossing
episodes.overview: The battle to bring a crime organization to justice reaches a new level; Reese's number comes up in the machine.

episodes.name: The Devil's Share
episodes.overview: As the POI team seeks justice for Carter’s murder, Finch realizes one of his team members may go one step too far in order to end the war with HR. Also, The Machine gives out the number for NYPD Officer Patrick Simmons, one of the crime organization’s key players.

episodes.name: Lethe
episodes.overview: Flashbacks to Finch’s adolescence provide insight into his creation of The Machine. Also, the team receives the number of an already dying man, and Reese leaves the POI team behind in the aftermath of the war with the crime organization, HR.

episodes.name: Aletheia
episodes.overview: Multiple enemies converge on the POI team as they protect a dying man whose number has come up. They struggle to keep their enemies at bay but without Reese, who has left them and their mission behind following the tragic war with HR, being down one man could have catastrophic repercussions for the team.

episodes.name: 4C
episodes.overview: Reese boards an international flight in an attempt to put the team and the past behind him, but is angered when he realizes his travel plans have been manipulated.

episodes.name: Provenance
episodes.overview: Reese rejoins Finch in New York, but when the team receives the number of a highly skilled antiquities thief, a surprising turn of events finds them planning a heist which could land them all in jail.

episodes.name: Last Call
episodes.overview: Finch goes undercover in an emergency call center to protect a 911 operator, but it soon becomes clear that the threat reaches further than the team could have anticipated.

episodes.name: RAM
episodes.overview: The secrets of Finch’s operation before he enlisted Reese are revealed, including shocking ties to present-day events.
The Machine assigns Root to seek out a janitor with a mysterious past, but when her very presence puts his life in danger, Finch also receives his number.

episodes.name: Allegiance
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese must delve into the murky waters of international politics when they are given the number of a former government contractor who is stalking a UN diplomat. Also, an enemy attempts to gain an upper hand on Root.

episodes.name: Most Likely To...
episodes.overview: Reese and Shaw pose as alumni at a high school reunion in order to keep eyes on the latest POI. Meanwhile, Finch and Fusco travel to Washington, D.C., to investigate the motivations behind Vigilance’s latest attack.

episodes.name: Death Benefit
episodes.overview: Reese poses as a Secret Service agent to get close to the latest POI, a U.S. congressman who may hold the key to derailing Decima’s plans to bring a second Machine online.

episodes.name: Beta
episodes.overview: As Decima uses Samaritan’s feeds to hunt Reese and Shaw, Greer exploits Finch’s greatest weakness in an attempt to lure him out of hiding: his love for his former fiancée, Grace Hendricks.

episodes.name: A House Divided
episodes.overview: When an unknown entity prevents The Machine from seeing the full picture of an impending catastrophic event, it sends the team five separate numbers to help them piece together the bigger picture. Meanwhile, Root’s team of hackers arrives in New York.

episodes.name: Deus Ex Machina
episodes.overview: The team takes desperate action in its race to prevent the malevolent AI program Samaritan from coming online and making them its first targets. Meanwhile, the months-long battle with the anti-surveillance terrorist group Vigilance comes to a shocking conclusion.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Although they’ve saved countless lives thanks to The Machine’s omniscience, John Reese and Harold Finch, along with lethal operative Sameen Shaw and unpredictable cyber-hacker Root now face an uncertain future. With a second machine — Samaritan — now online, the elusive team are now targets themselves, hiding in plain sight. The only thing more frightening than the ruthless Decima organization calling the shots is leaving those decisions up to an untested Machine. Facing a dangerous tomorrow, the POI team must find a way to outsmart Samaritan, an all-seeing, all-powerful artificial intelligence that’s self-governing, continually evolving and growing stronger every day.

episodes.name: Panopticon
episodes.overview: Forced to take on new identities provided by Root, the team members try to adapt to their new lives. However, some find it hard to ignore The Machine's numbers, which puts them all at risk of being detected by Samaritan.

episodes.name: Nautilus
episodes.overview: Despite not wanting to help with the new numbers, Finch's interest is piqued when the newest person of interest turns out to be a brilliant college student involved with a mysterious scavenger hunt.

episodes.name: Wingman
episodes.overview: Finch recruits Fusco to stick close to the latest POI, a professional 'wingman', but learning how to approach women soon becomes the least of his worries. Reese must find a way to play by the rules at his new day job. The Machine sends Finch and Root on a mysterious errand.

episodes.name: Brotherhood
episodes.overview: Reese's cover job as a detective at the NYPD becomes complicated when the young brother and sister he's protecting become targets of a gang investigation.

episodes.name: Prophets
episodes.overview: While Reese is forced to go to counseling for his violent tendencies, Root, Shaw and Finch try to help a new POI.

episodes.name: Pretenders
episodes.overview: Reese, Shaw and Fusco must protect a unassuming office worker who stumbles into a dangerous conspiracy while moonlighting as fake detective. Finch travels to Hong Kong as part of his academic cover identity.

episodes.name: Honor Among Thieves
episodes.overview: Shaw joins a team of international thieves in order to keep tabs on the latest POI, but an unexpected turn of events puts her in danger of being detected by Samaritan.  Also, Finch and Root undertake a dangerous sabotage mission.

episodes.name: Point of Origin
episodes.overview: Reese volunteers as an NYPD police academy instructor in order to keep an eye on a talented young officer whose suspicious actions make him question her motives. Meanwhile, Martine – armed with information from Samaritan – hunts a member of the team.

episodes.name: The Devil You Know
episodes.overview: Reese must save Elias from the Brotherhood. He can't get any help from Root or Shaw since Shaw's cover is blown and Root is escorting her to underground.

episodes.name: The Cold War
episodes.overview: Samaritan shows its power by erasing crime from the city for a day in an attempt to force The Machine out of hiding.

episodes.name: If-Then-Else
episodes.overview: Samaritan launches a cyber-attack on the stock exchange, forcing the team to risk their lives in a desperate mission to stop a global economic catastrophe.

episodes.name: Control-Alt-Delete
episodes.overview: Control, who oversees the handling of relevant numbers for the government, begins to question the methods and intentions of the Samaritan program. Also, alarming news reports of a pair of vigilantes rampaging through the Northeast begin to surface.

episodes.name: M.I.A.
episodes.overview: Root and Reese investigate a small town in upstate New York that holds the key to Shaw's location... and whether she's dead or alive.

episodes.name: Guilty
episodes.overview: When the Machine arranges for Finch to sit on the jury of a murder trial, he begins to suspect that a fellow juror is set to rig the proceedings. Meanwhile, Reese begins to open up to the department’s therapist.

episodes.name: Q&A
episodes.overview: Reese tries to protect a software programmer with a mysterious second life, but it’s unclear which side of her life the threat is coming from. Meanwhile, Claire, a young hacker whom Finch tried to protect from Samaritan, reaches out to him for aid.

episodes.name: Blunt
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch must protect Harper, a street-smart grifter, when her plan to steal cash from a medical marijuana dispensary goes up in smoke.

episodes.name: Karma
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch try to protect a psychologist whose unorthodox methods for helping his patients find closure could cost him dearly. Meanwhile, flashbacks reveal Finch’s fragile state in the days following the bombing that killed his best friend, Nathan Ingram.

episodes.name: Skip
episodes.overview: Reese must protect a bounty hunter who refuses to allow the potential threat to her life sway her from the relentless pursuit of her target. Also, Finch tries to set the plan he began in Shanghai in motion.

episodes.name: Search and Destroy
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch scramble to protect a software CEO when his behavior becomes increasingly erratic following a hacker attack that reveals all his secrets and unravels his life.

episodes.name: Terra Incognita
episodes.overview: Reese finds himself on a dangerous personal journey when he takes on a homicide case Detective Carter was never able to close.

episodes.name: Asylum
episodes.overview: Reese and Fusco get caught in the war between the two newest POIs, rival crime bosses Elias and Dominic. Also, a tantalizing clue to Shaw’s whereabouts leads Finch and Root into a possible trap, and Control goes rogue to uncover the true intentions of the Samaritan program.

episodes.name: YHWH
episodes.overview: Finch and Root race to save The Machine, which has been located by the rival AI, Samaritan. Also, Reese is caught in the middle of the final showdown between rival crime bosses Elias and Dominic.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: For years, the Person of Interest team have been protected by The Machine, but as worlds collided and a rival AI known as Samaritan finally cornered The Machine inside the nation’s power grid, it was the POI team’s turn to protect Finch’s creation. In season five, the cold war is over. The world around us might look the same, but something has drastically changed. Samaritan’s lethal “correction” has initiated its control. Finch’s Machine is essentially dead. Shaw is still missing. And the team is once again hiding in plain sight. But with Samaritan’s invisible grip tightening everywhere, will Finch be able to rebuild and resurrect The Machine? And if he does, will it be the same Machine when it comes back online?

episodes.name: B.S.O.D.
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch attempt to rescue the Machine’s source code before it deteriorates beyond repair. Also, Root fights for her life against an onslaught of Samaritan’s agents and Fusco is faced with hard questions following the deaths of Dominic and Elias.

episodes.name: SNAFU
episodes.overview: The Machine experiences a glitch during rebooting, supplying Reese and Fusco with the numbers of dozens of people not actually involved in crimes, while also locking Finch and Root out after identifying them as threats based on past violent behavior.

episodes.name: Truth Be Told
episodes.overview: Reese’s cover could be blown when he realizes the latest POI has ties to his old CIA colleague, Kara Stanton.
Shaw escapes her captors, but the team is unsure of her mental state when she begins to act paranoid and reckless.

episodes.name: ShotSeeker
episodes.overview: Reese protects an NYPD analyst whose investigation into a software glitch has drawn the attention of Samaritan. Also, Reese and Fusco are threatened by an ally of Elias’s, who is looking to avenge his friend’s death.

episodes.name: A More Perfect Union
episodes.overview: The Machine sends Reese and Finch to a wedding to protect a pair of POIs before their nuptials. Also, Fusco becomes angry at being kept in the dark by the team and takes it upon himself to investigate a string of missing person reports.

episodes.name: QSO
episodes.overview: Root goes undercover at a radio station to protect the host of a conspiracy theory show who stumbles upon information that could get him killed. Also, Samaritan’s agents try to convince a member of the team that their goals are noble.

episodes.name: Reassortment
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch become trapped in a hospital that becomes ground zero for a deadly viral outbreak. Also, Samaritan’s newest recruit has second thoughts and Shaw continues to struggle with reality.

episodes.name: Sotto Voce
episodes.overview: The mysterious criminal mastermind known as “The Voice” returns and traps Reese and Fusco in their own precinct with several armed gang members and the latest POI. Also, Root makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: The Day the World Went Away
episodes.overview: Finch’s number comes up when a fatal error blows his cover identity and sets off a deadly series of escalating encounters with Samaritan’s operatives.

episodes.name: Synecdoche
episodes.overview: The team must unravel a conspiracy and stay ahead of the Secret Service when the President of the United States becomes their newest POI. Also, Finch separates himself from the team and considers taking drastic action to combat Samaritan.

episodes.name: .exe
episodes.overview: As Reese and Shaw race to catch up with Finch, he infiltrates a maximum-security government facility in a desperate mission which could mean the end for not only Samaritan, but for himself and The Machine as well.

episodes.name: return 0
episodes.overview: Finch, Reese, Fusco and Shaw embark on one last mission to prevent Samaritan from destroying The Machine and cementing its hold over mankind.

shows.name: Pluribus
shows.overview: The most miserable person on Earth must save the world from happiness.

episodes.name: We Is Us
episodes.overview: An astronomer's discovery turns the planet upside down. Carol Sturka, a curmudgeonly novelist, is terrified by this strange new world.

episodes.name: Pirate Lady
episodes.overview: A curiously familiar face introduces Carol to the bizarre new normal. A gathering in Europe brings strangers together…and causes friction.

episodes.name: Grenade
episodes.overview: The World just wants to help—which infuriates Carol. A heart-to-heart conversation ends with a bang.

shows.name: Power Book IV: Force
shows.overview: Tommy Egan leaves New York behind and plans to take on Chicago, using his outsider status to break all the local rules and rewrite them on his quest to become the biggest drug dealer in the city.

episodes.name: Do or Die
episodes.overview: With some of his biggest obstacles off the map, Tommy faces new opportunities and challenges in his quest to take over the Chicago drug game.

episodes.name: A Seat at the Table
episodes.overview: Tommy's ambition sets him on a dangerous path, testing his alliances and endangering those close to him.

shows.name: The End of the F***ing World
shows.overview: James is 17 and is pretty sure he is a psychopath. Alyssa, also 17, is the cool and moody new girl at school. The pair make a connection and she persuades him to embark on a darkly comedic road trip in search of her real father.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A budding teen psychopath and a rebel hungry for adventure embark on a star-crossed road trip in this darkly comic series based on a graphic novel.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Bored with killing animals, 17-year-old James is busy plotting his first real murder when brash new girl Alyssa catches him off guard at school.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: On the road, James and Alyssa quickly realize they're in over their heads, but neither wants to admit it. A friendly army vet offers them help.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hoping to lie low for a few days, the pair breaks into a home stocked with swanky amenities -- and a disturbing secret.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Alyssa begins to see James in a new light as they scramble to cover their tracks and alter their appearance after a harrowing night.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A flashback to a painful moment from childhood prompts James to change his plans. Out of cash, Alyssa resorts to shoplifting.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: James reveals he's a man of hidden talents, Alyssa squares off with a shrewd gas station manager, and Eunice makes a startling discovery.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: As Alyssa reconnects with her dad, a worried James faces a dilemma. Eunice and Teri clash over the best way to approach the teens.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Eunice goes rogue, Leslie shows his true colors, and Alyssa and James plan their escape -- but soon realize they're out of time.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Two years later, Alyssa dives headfirst into a new life – just as a woman with a grudge sets out on a murderous quest for revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Newly released from prison, a brooding young woman named Bonnie sets out to avenge the death of her lover.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Just as Alyssa claws her way back to a semblance of a normal life, she discovers her past isn't done with her yet.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After an awkward encounter at the café, Alyssa wakes up on her big day with nagging doubts about what she wants from life.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: A flat tire forces the unlikely trio of travelers to seek refuge at a roadside inn run by a man who's desperate for company.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: While Bonnie scrambles to cover her tracks and tend to her injury, James tries to figure out where things stand with Alyssa.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Alyssa decides it's time to set things right at home, James searches for a new plan, and Bonnie resumes her quest with fresh vigor.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: After discovering Bonnie's true intentions, James races to help Alyssa, and a tense showdown unfolds inside the café.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Desperate to banish visions of the night at Clive's house, Alyssa suddenly disappears, sending James into a panic.

shows.name: Robin Hood
shows.overview: A modern reimagining of the classic tale. After the Norman invasion of England, Rob, a Saxon forester’s son, and Marian, a Norman lord’s daughter, fall in love and unite to fight for justice, challenge corruption, and restore peace to the land.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 12th-century England, Robert of Locksley rises from grief to rebellion. With Marian at his side and outlaws at his back, Rob defies the Sheriff of Nottingham and Norman rule. His fight for freedom will give birth to the legend of Robin Hood.

episodes.name: I See Him
episodes.overview: We meet Robert of Locksley, a young Saxon whose world is shattered by injustice. His struggle to right a personal wrong will forge him into something legendary...not just a man, but a symbol.

episodes.name: A Heinous Devil
episodes.overview: After witnessing his father's brutal execution, a young Saxon forester, Robert of Locksley, begins a dangerous descent into vengeance that will ignite a legend.

episodes.name: No Man Can Hide Forever
episodes.overview: The death of Huntingdon's son deepens the rift between Normans and Saxons. Rob gains a powerful ally in Little John, but the Sheriff's pursuit grows, driving the outlaws deeper into Sherwood. Marian enters the dazzling yet perilous court in Westminster.

episodes.name: The Cause of This Unrest
episodes.overview: Rob and his band target the Sheriff's reward money — a bold heist that could change their fortunes, if it doesn't first get them killed.

episodes.name: Go Back to Them
episodes.overview: Rob risks all to save the Millers from hanging. In Westminster, Marian's world tilts with news of her brother's death.

episodes.name: Bound by Love, Divided by Lies
episodes.overview: Queen Eleanor arrives in Nottingham, throwing the Barons, and the Sheriff, into turmoil. Rob and Marian are reunited at last.

episodes.name: Thieves with a Purpose
episodes.overview: Rob acts on his secret pact. Meanwhile, Prince John arrives in Westminster, and Marian is drawn into a dangerous attraction.

shows.name: RuPaul's Drag Race
shows.overview: Join RuPaul, the world's most famous drag queen, as the host, mentor and judge for the ultimate in drag queen competitions. The top drag queens in the U.S. will vie for drag stardom as RuPaul, in full glamazon drag, will reign supreme in all judging and eliminations while helping guide the contestants as they prepare for each challenge.

shows.name: Nightmare Teacher
shows.overview: A homeroom teacher of Yosan Private High School has an accident, and thus a substitute comes to fill in. Han Bong-Gu  is a mysterious man, and after strange occurrences the class president Ye-Rim tries to get to the bottom of this mystery.

shows.ref_name: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars: Untucked
shows.name: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars: UNTUCKED
shows.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway. See what happens behind the scenes when the queens let their tucks breathe... and let their emotions flow.

episodes.name: Winner Winner, Chicken Dinner
episodes.overview: The Bracket 1 Queens storm the Untucked Lounge for the first time in the Tournament of All Stars to dissect the points twist, which seriously affects how they play the game. Guest judge Ice Spice gags for the Queens’ looks.

episodes.name: Murder on the Dance Floor
episodes.overview: This week, the All Stars need more than a crystal ball to predict how many points they’ll have at the end of the night. Alliances crumble as the Queens wonder how they will make it to the semi-finals. Guest judge Colman Domingo helps the Queens loosen up.

episodes.name: Hoop Queens Makeovers
episodes.overview: Tensions peak as the Bracket 1 Queens face their final judgment before the semi-finals! The Lady Ballers join for a kiki and guest judge Kate Beckinsale brings Hollywood glamour to the Untucked lounge.

episodes.name: Eight Ball
episodes.overview: The Bracket 2 Queens stir the pot in the Untucked Lounge. As playful tension starts to brew, it's clear these girls aren't here for kumbaya... And one Queen's bottom placement pushes her to start playing strategically.

episodes.name: Rappin' Roast
episodes.overview: An emotional reveal on the main stage strikes a chord between two Queens. But as sisterhood blooms, another Queen presents a controversial proposal that could tear it apart. Guest judge Chappell Roan cements her icon status with the girls.

episodes.name: Starrbooty: The Rebooty
episodes.overview: The Bracket 2 Queens strategize right up until the final moments on the main stage. Despite some rocky moments, they agree that returning to All Stars was truly special. After a shocking twist, the semi-finalists celebrate.

episodes.name: Wicked Good
episodes.overview: The Bracket 3 Queens are feeling confident in the aftermath of the design challenge, while new friendships are forming in the Untucked Lounge. The wicked-fabulous Guest Judges Ariana Grande and Cynthia Erivo surprise the Queens with a sweet treat!

episodes.name: Stagecooch
episodes.overview: The Queens are feeling their Miley Cyrus looks. After a day of discussing points, gameplay is on everyone's minds - and one Queen worries that her sisters are not behind her. Another Queen's bold proclamation may have backed her into a corner.

episodes.name: The Golden Bitchelor
episodes.overview: The All Stars of Bracket 3 untuck one last time. Emotions run high as they wonder who will win this week's Maxi Challenge, how queens will award their final MVQ Points, and who will move on to the Semi-Finals.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Before the first elimination, the Semi-Finalists face the heat in the Untucked Lounge. One Queen's gameplaying backfires, while guest judge Sarah Michelle Gellar's visit leaves everyone gagged.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Talent Invitational
episodes.overview: With the Talent Show behind them, the Queens argue over who is in danger this week - and one Queen reflects on her emotional journey, as the final elimination looms.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Smackdown for the Crown
episodes.overview: Excitement and nerves fill the werkroom as the Queens prep for the Lip Sync Smackdown for the Crown. After each elimination, the Queens dish and kiki as they wait to see who will take home the Crown.

shows.name: RuPaul's Drag Race UK
shows.overview: RuPaul has made the trip across the pond in search of a queen with the most charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent in all the land.

seasons.name: Series 7
seasons.overview: Rest Easy. Mama's back! Start your engines, as a brand new set of fabulous queens enter the werkroom, hoping to win Mama Ru's seal of approval and take home the crown.

episodes.name: Queens of the Brit Gala
episodes.overview: A hot new cast of queens enter the werk room as RuPaul kicks off his legendary race. Joel Dommett joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Rumble in the Jumble
episodes.overview: Supermodel turned comedy star Michelle de Swarte joins Mama Ru, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel as the queens take on the iconic Design Challenge.

episodes.name: Battle of the Brats
episodes.overview: The queens take on a hyperpop banger for the Girl Group challenge. Girls Aloud legend Nadine Coyle joins RuPaul, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Sweety Darlings!
episodes.overview: There’s bonk-busting drama as actor Jane Horrocks joins Ru, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel, and the queens star in an absolutely fabulous acting challenge.

episodes.name: Talent Ahoy!
episodes.overview: The queens take to the high seas for a cruise-themed talent show. Derry Girl Jamie-Lee O’Donnell joins RuPaul, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: It’s Rusical week! West End musical theatre legend Mazz Murray joins Mama Ru, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel as the curtain comes down on yet another queen.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Susan Wokoma, Jordan North, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr all join Ru as the queens fight it out to prove they have the best celebrity dating and improv skills on Snatch Me Out!

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The queens give drag makeovers to hun legends Diane Parish, Shobna Gulati, Charlotte Church, Michelle McManus, Dani Harmer and David Potts. Mutya Buena joins the judging panel.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: It's the semi-finals! BAFTA winner Sophie Willan joins RuPaul as the remaining queens try to secure a place in the final with their best stand-up in the comedy roast challenge.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: It’s the grand finale! Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton and the eliminated queens are all on hand as RuPaul crowns the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

shows.name: RuPaul's Drag Race: Untucked
shows.overview: The access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway—the backstage bitchiness, the catfights, the struggles, the tears and the secrets. See what happens behind the scenes of RuPaul's Drag Race when the queens let their tucks breathe... and let their emotions flow.

episodes.name: Squirrel Games
episodes.overview: The queens celebrate week one with a champagne toast in the all-new Untucked Lounge. The queens break off into groups wondering how tonight’s Rate-A-Queen vote will turn out. Katy Perry stops by to give her two cents on the talent show.

episodes.name: Drag Queens Got Talent - Part 2
episodes.overview: After the talent show, things start to get real in the Untucked Lounge. It’s time for the week two girls to be judged in Rate-A-Queen and one queen’s strong opinions quickly turns her fellow competitors against her.

episodes.name: Monopulence!
episodes.overview: Tensions still run high in the aftermath of the Monopulence design challenge. The bottom queens are emotional after critiques, and one queen rubs her sisters the wrong way. Queer icon, Sandra Bernhard shares the lessons she’s learned during her amazing career.

episodes.name: Bitch, I'm a Drag Queen!
episodes.overview: The safe queens don’t see eye to eye on the tops and bottoms this week, but they all agree that one queen’s look was the worst on the runway.  Everyone is gagged when a confident queen finally loses her cool. There are tears and anger in the lounge as the queens realize the game is heating up and no one is really safe.

episodes.name: RDR Live!
episodes.overview: Drag delusion settles into the Untucked Lounge. Feeling salty about landing in the bottom, one Queen calls out her sisters. A funny runway divides the room and everyone is bothered. Paul W. Downs gets the Queens out of their heads with some good advice.

episodes.name: Let's Get Sea Sickening Ball
episodes.overview: It's sink or swim after the Sea Sickening Ball. One Queen is shook after her confidence is put to the test. Guest Judge and trans trailblazer Hunter Schafer visits the lounge and gets her flowers from the Queens.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: After the Snatch Game critiques, a safe placement has left one Queen a little salty. A Queen with a strong track record lands in the bottom. Guest Judge Quinta Brunson uplifts the Queens.

episodes.name: The Wicked Wiz of Oz: The Rusical!
episodes.overview: The safe Queens are feeling playful and decide to mess with the rest of the girls. One Queen questions the difficulty of her sister's role in the Rusical. Guest judge Adam Lambert thrills the Queens by stopping by and sharing his journey.

episodes.name: Heavens To Betsey!
episodes.overview: The Queens are campaigning hard for a particular bottom Queen to be sent home. The critiqued Queens interrupt a chaotic moment in the lounge. Guest judge Betsey Johnson stops by and gets the Queens out of their heads and on their feet.

episodes.name: The Villains Roast
episodes.overview: Unresolved tension from this week's challenge comes to a head in the Untucked lounge; Two friends are torn apart, and two friends strengthen their bond; One Queen makes an enemy after standing up for her sister.

episodes.name: Ross Mathews vs. The Ducks
episodes.overview: Harsh realities are sinking in after the Queens reveal their picks to go home. Two Queens feel defeated after finding themselves in the bottom. Guest judge Sam Smith shares his favorite way to wind down after a long day.

episodes.name: Charisma, Uniqueness, Nerve & Talent Monologues
episodes.overview: The spirit of delusion is alive and well in the Untucked lounge. One Queen does not understand why she is not in the top this week. While another Queen pins her hopes of staying on a long shot.

episodes.name: Drag Baby Mamas
episodes.overview: The Queens and their parents celebrate the completion of an emotionally charged makeover challenge. After the parents leave, the mood in the lounge quickly turns bittersweet. The finale is fast approaching and not everyone is going to make it to the end.

episodes.name: How's Your Headliner?
episodes.overview: The top Queens enter the Untucked lounge for the final time. Their fates are uncertain, but they all agree that they have had the time of their lives. Guest judge, Tracee Ellis Ross stops by to thank the Queens for putting on an amazing show.

shows.name: Severance
shows.overview: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: At Lumon Industries, employees undergo "severance," a procedure dividing their work and personal memories. Mark, a grieving team leader, begins to uncover the dark secrets of the company, forcing him and his coworkers to confront questions of identity, free will, and corporate control.

episodes.name: Good News About Hell
episodes.overview: Mark is promoted to lead a team who've had their memories surgically divided between their work and personal lives.

episodes.name: Half Loop
episodes.overview: The team train new hire Helly on macrodata refinement. Mark takes a day off to meet with a mysterious former colleague.

episodes.name: In Perpetuity
episodes.overview: Mark takes the team on a field trip, but Helly continues to rebel. A deteriorating Petey struggles to tell Mark about Lumon’s misdeeds.

episodes.name: The You You Are
episodes.overview: Irving finds an intriguing book at work. Helly aggressively pursues a meeting with her Outie. Mark attends a funeral with Ms. Selvig.

episodes.name: The Grim Barbarity of Optics and Design
episodes.overview: Irving and Dylan confront Burt about his lies. Mark and Helly discover a strange new department.

episodes.name: Hide and Seek
episodes.overview: The team angers Cobel by forming an alliance.

episodes.name: Defiant Jazz
episodes.overview: Mark and the team encounter new security measures from Cobel.

episodes.name: What's for Dinner?
episodes.overview: The team prepares a plan. Mark attends Devon and Ricken’s party.

episodes.name: The We We Are
episodes.overview: The team discovers troubling revelations.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Mark and his friends learn the dire consequences of trifling with the severance barrier, leading them further down a path of woe.

episodes.name: Hello, Ms. Cobel
episodes.overview: Mark returns to work under different circumstances. Secrets from the Outie world come to light.

episodes.name: Goodbye, Mrs. Selvig
episodes.overview: Mark contemplates the meaning of a message.

episodes.name: Who Is Alive?
episodes.overview: Mark, Helly, Irving, and Dylan search for answers.

episodes.name: Woe's Hollow
episodes.overview: The team participates in a group activity.

episodes.name: Trojan's Horse
episodes.overview: Tensions emerge after the team suffers a loss.

episodes.name: Attila
episodes.overview: Bonds are tested. Mark continues on his path of discovery.

episodes.name: Chikhai Bardo
episodes.overview: An old romance intersects with a deadly present threat.

episodes.name: Sweet Vitriol
episodes.overview: Discoveries are made.

episodes.name: The After Hours
episodes.overview: Mark and Devon team with an ally. Helly investigates further.

episodes.name: Cold Harbor
episodes.overview: Mark forms a shaky alliance in an all-or-nothing play, while the team makes a dangerous last stand.

shows.name: Shifting Gears
shows.overview: Matt is a stubborn, widowed owner of a classic car restoration shop. When Matt's estranged daughter Riley and her teenage kids move into his house, the real restoration begins.

episodes.name: Secret
episodes.overview: Matt wrestles with his feelings for Eve, and Charlotte convinces him to go to a grief group. Meanwhile, Riley struggles with her own “will she or won’t she” about her feelings for Gabe.

episodes.name: Date
episodes.overview: Matt and Eve go on their first date but have different ideas of what it should entail; Riley befriends the mom of Georgia's new friend; Carter mediates a tiff between Gabe and Stitch.

episodes.name: Passion
episodes.overview: When Carter's job pays more than Riley's, she decides to find her forever career and clashes with Matt over her future; Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias drops by Parker Customs; Matt debates letting go of a piece of the past.

episodes.name: Danger
episodes.overview: When a raccoon appears in the Parkers’ yard, Matt sees a chance to teach Carter a lesson about facing his fears. Meanwhile, Riley struggles to navigate the world of dating apps and goes on her first post-divorce date.

episodes.name: Scary
episodes.overview: Matt plans to spend Halloween with Eve, but the real terror begins when she wants to sleep over. With Carter and Georgia out for the night, Riley invites Gabe and Stitch to a party, hoping to relive the crazy, epic Halloweens of her past.

episodes.name: Loyalty
episodes.overview: Matt's dream build turns into a nightmare when controversy threatens to derail everything.

shows.name: Star Trek: Starfleet Academy
shows.overview: A young group of cadets come together to pursue a common dream of hope and optimism. Under the watchful and demanding eyes of their instructors, they will discover what it takes to become Starfleet officers as they navigate blossoming friendships, explosive rivalries, first loves and a new enemy that threatens both the Academy and the Federation itself.

shows.name: Stranger Things
shows.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 5
seasons.overview: The fall of 1987. Hawkins is scarred by the opening of the Rifts, and our heroes are united by a single goal: find and kill Vecna. But he has vanished — his whereabouts and plans unknown. Complicating their mission, the government has placed the town under military quarantine and intensified its hunt for Eleven, forcing her back into hiding. As the anniversary of Will's disappearance approaches, so does a heavy, familiar dread. The final battle is looming — and with it, a darkness more powerful and more deadly than anything they've faced before. To end this nightmare, they'll need everyone — the full party — standing together, one last time.

shows.name: Ragnarok
shows.overview: A small Norwegian town experiencing warm winters and violent downpours seems to be headed for another Ragnarök -- unless someone intervenes in time.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a Norwegian town poisoned by pollution and rattled by melting glaciers, the End Times feel all too real. It’ll take a legend to battle an old evil.

episodes.name: New Boy
episodes.overview: Returning to his family’s hometown, awkward teenager Magne discovers his strange new powers. Still, the hamlet's natural beauty cloaks dark secrets.

episodes.name: 541 Meters
episodes.overview: Magne and his classmates try to regroup after a tragic loss, while the police seem uninterested in getting to the truth. Gry stumbles on Vidar unmasked.

episodes.name: Jutulheim
episodes.overview: The break-in confirms what Magne suspects: He must take matters into his own hands. After tying up loose ends, the Jutuls put the teen to the test.

episodes.name: Ginnungagap
episodes.overview: A search for answers brings Magne back to a mysterious woman — and a meaningful mountain. Turid confronts Ran, and former BFFs Gry and Saxa get heated.

episodes.name: Atomic Number 48
episodes.overview: As Fjor holds Vidar back, Magne takes the blame, then tries a new tack. Threats abound, and the greatest is the explosive find that Isolde left behind.

episodes.name: Yes, We Love This Country
episodes.overview: While attempting to expose the truth, Magne gets another shock. Hope seems lost, but have the Jutuls underestimated their foe — and the power of good?

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Mythical chaos looms as Magne looks for help in his continuing fight against giant foes and deals with an unmanageable brother with godlike powers.

episodes.name: Brothers in Arms
episodes.overview: A battle ends with a bang — and an ominous promise of violence. After visiting another realm, Magne hunts for allies while Vidar marshals his forces.

episodes.name: What Happened to the Nice, Old Lady?
episodes.overview: The truth hurts, and a fight for hearts and minds kicks off. Vidar gets under Magne's skin, Iman feels her power, and Laurits discovers his dark side.

episodes.name: Power to the People
episodes.overview: Edda rises: Magne confronts Ran, and Laurits proves a point. As protests gather momentum, a king walks again, and a master manipulator gets played.

episodes.name: God Is God, Though All Men Death Had Tasted
episodes.overview: A patriarch passes — and a strange new creature is born. Magne tries to change, Laurits lashes out and Fjor charts a new path. Saxa and Iman step up.

episodes.name: Know Yourself
episodes.overview: In a seismic shift, Magne rejects strength, Fjor makes a power grab and a circle closes ranks. Laurits learns the truth, and Iman reaches out to Ran.

episodes.name: All You Need Is Love
episodes.overview: Desperate times fire up Magne and his crew as they go on a risky mission. The Jutuls face an unforeseen enemy while a formidable ancient force awakens.

episodes.name: War Is Over
episodes.overview: Bereft of his hammer, Magne continues to battle the Giants while complying with modern rules. But when he breaks a pact, the truce crumbles.

episodes.name: Till Death Do Us Part
episodes.overview: The Jutuls decide to play along with Magne's antics to make him more open to Saxa's plan. Feeling rejected by everyone, Laurits finds support in Jens.

episodes.name: Losing My Religion
episodes.overview: Under Saxa's spell, Magne continues to fall further from himself — a perfect distraction for Fjor to enact his vicious plan and set a dangerous trap.

episodes.name: My Precious
episodes.overview: More vulnerable than ever, Magne requires backup to face his relentless foes. An impossible ultimatum threatens Laurits' loved ones.

episodes.name: A Farewell to Arms
episodes.overview: As Magne's arrogance sows discord among his allies, the gods stand at a crossroads between forging lasting peace or fighting the impending battle.

episodes.name: Ragnarok
episodes.overview: Despite Edda's embrace of a new dawn, the young God of Thunder cannot evade the predestined future that awaits.

shows.name: The Boys
shows.overview: A group of vigilantes known informally as “The Boys” set out to take down corrupt superheroes with no more than blue-collar grit and a willingness to fight dirty.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The story takes place in a universe where most of the superpowered individuals are recognized as superheroes, but in reality abuse their powers for personal gain, information the public is kept unaware of.

episodes.name: The Name of the Game
episodes.overview: When a Supe kills the love of his life, A/V salesman Hughie Campbell teams up with Billy Butcher, a vigilante hell-bent on punishing corrupt Supes — and Hughie’s life will never be the same again.

episodes.name: Cherry
episodes.overview: The Boys get themselves a Superhero, Starlight gets payback, Homelander gets naughty, and a Senator gets naughtier.

episodes.name: Get Some
episodes.overview: It’s the race of the century. A-Train versus Shockwave, vying for the title of World’s Fastest Man. Meanwhile, the Boys are reunited and it feels so good.

episodes.name: The Female of the Species
episodes.overview: On a very special episode of The Boys… an hour of guts, gutterballs, airplane hijackings, madness, ghosts, and one very intriguing Female. Oh, and lots of heart — both in the sentimental sense, and in the gory literal sense.

episodes.name: Good for the Soul
episodes.overview: The Boys head to the “Believe” Expo to follow a promising lead in their ongoing war against the Supes. There might — MIGHT — be a homicidal infant, but you’ll have to see for yourself.

episodes.name: The Innocents
episodes.overview: SUPER IN AMERICA (2019). Vought Studios. Genre: Reality. Starring: Homelander, Queen Maeve, Black Noir, The Deep, A-Train, Starlight, Tara Reid, Billy Zane.

episodes.name: The Self-Preservation Society
episodes.overview: Never trust a washed-up Supe — the Boys learn this lesson the hard way. Meanwhile, Homelander digs into his past, Starlight discovers that love hurts, and if you’re ever in Sandusky, Ohio and a girl asks if she can touch your gills, say NO.

episodes.name: You Found Me
episodes.overview: Season Finale Time! Questions answered! Secrets revealed! Conflicts… conflicted! Characters exploded! And so much more!

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The even more intense, more insane season two finds The Boys on the run from the law, hunted by the Supes, and desperately trying to regroup and fight back against Vought. In hiding, Hughie, Mother’s Milk, Frenchie and Kimiko try to adjust to a new normal, with Butcher nowhere to be found. Meanwhile, Starlight must navigate her place in The Seven as Homelander sets his sights on taking complete control. His power is threatened with the addition of Stormfront, a social media-savvy new Supe, who has an agenda of her own. On top of that, the Supervillain threat takes center stage and makes waves as Vought seeks to capitalize on the nation’s paranoia.

episodes.name: The Big Ride
episodes.overview: Season 2! New and improved! Now with 50% more explosive decapitations, terrorists, S&M hookers, cults, and a new pine fresh scent! But wait, there’s more! 2X MORE blood, guts and gore than the other leading brands! This exclusive offer is available only on Amazon Prime Video! Don’t delay! Order now!

episodes.name: Proper Preparation and Planning
episodes.overview: The Boys get themselves a Super Terrorist, Starlight gets evidence against Vought, The Deep gets in touch with his feelings, and Homelander gets himself a family (sort of).  All that, and a hard-hitting exposé on why Super Suits don’t have pockets.
